description: The current API only accept a div while the hardware supports frac as well. Make div as float so that we can support FRAC without breaking the existing applications. (C will silent cast int to float to make old code still compile)

comments.body: Might make sense to replace the `8u` here with `CLOCKS_CLK_GPOUT0_DIV_INT_LSB` ?
_Might_ be worth modifying this code to match the style of e.g. https://github.com/raspberrypi/pico-sdk/blob/develop/src/rp2_common/hardware_adc/include/hardware/adc.h#L164 ?
https://datasheets.raspberrypi.com/rp2040/rp2040-datasheet.pdf implies that a DIV of 0 is perfectly valid?
should be a `uint8_t` ; will give compiler warnings
prefer changing the names to `div_int` and `div_frac` and updating the doxygen to be a bit more specific about integer, and fraction between 0 and 255

Could add an `invalid_params_if` to the .c file to check that `div_int < (1<<24)` ? With the 24 calculated as `CLOCKS_CLK_GPOUT0_DIV_INT_MSB - CLOCKS_CLK_GPOUT0_DIV_INT_LSB + 1` ?
(but if @kilograham disagrees, please listen to him rather than me :laughing: )
